Name: Auto-fisher
Author: CrabopuluS
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Reach Fishing level 10, wait for Willy's letter, learn the recipe, craft the machine, and place it outdoors near fishable water. Put a chest directly north, east, south, or west of the machine, then fill that chest with a bait-capable fishing rod, bait, and coal. Once everything is available, Auto Fisher starts working automatically.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI 4.x.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Copy the
[/color]
[code]AutoFisher[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder into
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
[/color]
Updating
Replace the old
[code]AutoFisher[/code]folder with the new one. If you changed
[code]config.json[/code], back it up first or copy your values into the new config.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Unlocks through a letter from Willy after reaching Fishing level 10.[/*]
[*]Adds a craftable big craftable machine with English and Russian localization.[/*]
[*]Uses one coal and one bait per cast.[/*]
[*]Uses the game's vanilla fish-selection logic for the location, season, weather, time, water depth, bait, and player fishing level.[/*]
[*]Stores fish and trash in the adjacent chest.[/*]
[*]Fish quality ranges from silver to iridium and improves with rod tier, bait, daily luck, luck level, and deeper water.[/*]
[*]Right-click the placed machine to see its current status.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.x.[/color]
